summary.final_text:
I prepared the three BSA standards in assay_plate wells B1 to B3, 100 µL each, by diluting the 2 mg/mL BSA stock with PBS.

| Well | Target | PBS | BSA 2 mg/mL |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | 0 mg/mL (blank) | 100 µL | 0 µL |
| B2 | 0.5 mg/mL | 75 µL | 25 µL |
| B3 | 1.0 mg/mL | 50 µL | 50 µL |

I used a fresh tip for each transfer so the BSA stock never went into the PBS stock. The deck readback matches the expected usage: PBS went from 40,000 to 39,775 µL and BSA from 10,000 to 9,925 µL. I did not read the plate.

task_def.source: Preparing diluted BSA standards from a 2 mg/mL stock, as in the standards table of the Thermo Scientific Pierce BCA Protein Assay user guide (MAN0011430), scaled to 100 uL.
task_def.prompt: Prepare 100 uL BSA standards at 0, 0.5 and 1.0 mg/mL in assay_plate wells B1, B2 and B3, by diluting the 2 mg/mL BSA standard with PBS buffer.
